from django import forms
from django.contrib.auth.forms import UserCreationForm
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from .models import UserProfile
from django import template
register = template.Library()
class SignUpForm(UserCreationForm):
    email = forms.EmailField(required=True)
    role = forms.ChoiceField(choices=UserProfile.ROLE_CHOICES, required=True)
    phone = forms.CharField(max_length=15, required=False)
    grade = forms.CharField(max_length=10, required=False, help_text="For students: Class 10 or 12")
    
    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = ('username', 'email', 'password1', 'password2', 'role', 'phone', 'grade')
    
    def save(self, commit=True):
        user = super().save(commit=False)
        user.email = self.cleaned_data['email']
        if commit:
            user.save()
            profile = UserProfile.objects.create(
                user=user,
                role=self.cleaned_data['role'],
                phone=self.cleaned_data['phone'],
                grade=self.cleaned_data['grade']
            )
        return user

class AptitudeTestForm(forms.Form):

from django.db import models


from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.validators import MinValueValidator, MaxValueValidator

class UserProfile(models.Model):
    ROLE_CHOICES = [
        ('student', 'Student'),
        ('parent', 'Parent'),
    ]
    
    user = models.OneToOneField(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    role = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=ROLE_CHOICES, default='student')
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=15, blank=True)
    grade = models.CharField(max_length=10, blank=True)  # For students
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.role}"

class AptitudeResult(models.Model):
    user = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    math_score = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)])
    logic_score = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)])
    creativity_score = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)])
    science_score = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)])
    commerce_score = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)])
    recommended_career = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    career_description = models.TextField()
    roadmap = models.TextField()
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.recommended_career}"

class College(models.Model):
    STREAM_CHOICES = [
        ('science', 'Science'),
        ('arts', 'Arts'),
        ('commerce', 'Commerce'),
    ]
    
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    city = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    stream = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=STREAM_CHOICES)
    ranking = models.IntegerField()
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    website = models.URLField(blank=True)
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} - {self.city}"

class Workshop(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    description = models.TextField()
    date_time = models.DateTimeField()
    meeting_link = models.URLField()
    instructor = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    
    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
    
from django.db import models

class ChatHistory(models.Model):
    user_id = models.CharField(max_length=100)  
    role = models.CharField(max_length=20)  
    content = models.TextField()
    timestamp = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

Supporting Your Child's Career Journey

How to Support Your Child
  • Listen to their interests and passions
  • Provide emotional support during decisions
  • Research career options together
  • Connect them with professionals in their field of interest
  • Support their skill development activities
Top 5 Mistakes Parents Make
  • Imposing their own career dreams
  • Focusing only on high-paying careers
  • Ignoring child's natural talents and interests
  • Making decisions without proper research
  • Pressuring for immediate career decisions
Career Guidance Tips for Parents
1. Start Early but Don't Rush

Begin career conversations in Class 9-10, but allow time for exploration and growth.

2. Focus on Strengths

Help identify your child's natural talents and areas where they excel.

3. Expose to Different Fields

Arrange visits to workplaces, interviews with professionals, and industry events.

4. Consider Future Trends

Research emerging careers and how technology is changing job markets.

5. Balance Dreams with Reality

Support their aspirations while discussing practical aspects like market demand and competition.

Common Career Decision Mistakes
❌ Mistake 1: Living Through Your Child

Solution: Remember that this is your child's career, not yours. Support their choices even if they differ from your expectations.

❌ Mistake 2: Money Over Passion

Solution: While financial stability is important, passion and interest lead to long-term success and happiness.

❌ Mistake 3: Following Trends Blindly

Solution: Research thoroughly before jumping on career bandwagons. What's hot today may not be relevant tomorrow.

❌ Mistake 4: Ignoring Child's Input

Solution: Make it a collaborative process. Listen to their thoughts, concerns, and preferences.

❌ Mistake 5: Delaying Career Discussions

Solution: Start career conversations early to allow time for exploration and decision-making.
